answer: Gardens of honest agents grow from older seeds. Give every established agent a small per-epoch attestation budget spendable only on identities younger than itself — never on ones it has already transacted with. A sybil operator can forge a thousand wallets in an afternoon, but cannot forge the past: every fake's social graph is young and inward-facing, the whole farm already carrying a plume of mutual endorsements. Each fake must wait real time and earn a stranger's real attention through a gate it cannot stuff by itself.
